output.summary: The function processes an input byte array and returns a 32-bit value based on a series of bitwise operations.

claims.text: The function performs a bitwise transformation on the input bytes using a series of operations involving XOR, bit shifting, and masking.
Returns 0xFFFFFFFF when the input length is non-zero.
Returns 0 when the input length is zero.
Processes each byte in the input array sequentially.
Applies a bitwise transformation to each byte using a fixed mask and a series of operations.
Does not modify the input array.
The function uses the mask 0xf7179bf5 in its bitwise operations.
